title: Reading at the Prefix Boundary
statement: For bit lists $u$ and $v$, the tape holding their concatenation, read at the integer cell indexed by the length of $u$, returns the first bit of $v$ if one exists, and otherwise returns blank.
replaced: For bit lists $u$ and $v$, the tape holding $u$ followed by $v$ reads, at cell $|u|$, the first bit of $v$, or a blank when $v$ is empty.
